name: Dhoop & Chandan Hero Jar Candle
materials: Natural soy wax, cotton wick, phthalate-free fragrance oils
packaging: Amber glass jar with metal lid, kraft gift sleeve
shortDescription: Sandalwood and dhoop, poured slow into our largest jar.
about: Poured in small batches into our signature amber apothecary jar, this candle opens with warm sandalwood and settles into a soft trail of dhoop. The cotton wick burns clean and even for a long, unhurried evening. Burn time of approximately 45 hours.

name: Madhuban Hero Jar Candle
materials: Natural soy wax, cotton wick, phthalate-free fragrance oils
packaging: Amber glass jar with metal lid, kraft gift sleeve
shortDescription: Raat ki Rani and rose, for the hour after sunset.
about: A deep floral pour built around Raat ki Rani and rose, designed for evenings that want to slow down. Sits beautifully on a bedside table or dinner table alike. Burn time of approximately 45 hours.

name: Gulab Ki Chitthi Hero Jar Candle
materials: Natural soy wax, cotton wick, phthalate-free fragrance oils
packaging: Amber glass jar with metal lid, kraft gift sleeve
shortDescription: Rose, folded like an old letter, in our biggest jar.
about: Soft rose layered with delicate florals, reminiscent of a handwritten letter tucked away for years. A quietly nostalgic candle that fills a room without overwhelming it. Burn time of approximately 45 hours.

name: Gajre Ka Shringar Wide Jar Candle
materials: Natural soy wax, cotton wick, phthalate-free fragrance oils
packaging: Wide glass jar with wooden lid, kraft gift sleeve

about: Jasmine and mogra layered into a fresh white floral, poured into our wide jar for a broader melt pool and faster fragrance throw. A lovely everyday size for smaller rooms. Burn time of approximately 28 hours.

name: Saanjh Wide Jar Candle
materials: Natural soy wax, cotton wick, phthalate-free fragrance oils
packaging: Wide glass jar with wooden lid, kraft gift sleeve
shortDescription: Soft amber and quiet woods, for the slow hour.
about: Amber and quiet woods designed for the hour when the day exhales — journaling, wind-downs, unhurried evenings. The wide jar gives an even burn and a generous scent throw. Burn time of approximately 28 hours.

name: Dhoop & Chandan Shot Glass Candle

packaging: Glass shot jar, kraft gift box
shortDescription: A small, sandalwood-warm votive for trying us out.
about: Our smallest pour — a compact shot-glass candle that's perfect as a sampler, a favour, or a first introduction to Mysaa. Burn time of approximately 12 hours.

name: Gulab Ki Chitthi Shot Glass Candle
materials: Natural soy wax, cotton wick, phthalate-free fragrance oils
packaging: Glass shot jar, kraft gift box
shortDescription: Rose in miniature — a keepsake-sized pour.
about: A small rose candle that makes a thoughtful add-on gift or wedding favour. Burn time of approximately 12 hours.

name: Madhuban Wax Melts
materials: Natural soy wax, phthalate-free fragrance oils
shortDescription: Raat ki Rani and rose, flameless.
about: For anyone who loves fragrance but prefers a flameless option — melt a cube in an oil burner for the same deep floral warmth as our Madhuban candle. Each pack holds 6 individually scored cubes.

name: Gajre Ka Shringar Wax Sachet Set

shortDescription: Jasmine and mogra, tucked into a wardrobe or bag.
about: Slip a sachet into a wardrobe, drawer or gym bag for a soft, lingering hit of jasmine and mogra — no flame or wax burner needed. Fragrance lasts 4–6 weeks per sachet.

name: Diwali Ritual Hamper
materials: Assorted candles, gift box, dried florals
about: A curated set spanning sandalwood warmth and rose nostalgia — one hero jar, one wide jar, and one shot glass candle, boxed together for festive gifting. Comes with a handwritten note card on request.

shortDescription: A small ritual to send along with a rakhi.
about: A wide jar candle in fresh jasmine and mogra, paired with a personalised card — a small, fragrant ritual to send between siblings. Add a name for the card at no extra cost.
